title: ÆTHER: First Love v16 (Malayalam lyrics by Mr. Kavi, romanised lines)
story: A boy sees a girl for the first time and falls in love, told by ONE love melody that is first hummed, then sung in Malayalam, and grows into a celebration.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 09:37 asked Mr. Kavi to write lyrics for First Love. v16 keeps v15b's one-melody form, G major, 92 BPM and instruments, as a composition plan so the words land in their sections; lyric sheet in /mnt/project-files/music/first-love-v16/first-love-v16-lyrics.md. v16 has the lines in Malayalam script, v16r the same lines romanised, to learn which ElevenLabs sings better.

positive_global_styles: one single South Indian style love song built on ONE memorable love melody that returns again and again
bright G major the whole way with the magical raised fourth of raga Kalyani
one steady 92 BPM pulse from start to end

one soft sweet close female voice singing the words in Malayalam (the lines are Malayalam written in English letters), clear natural diction, gamakam slides and a long held note that bends at the end of each line
soft wordless female humming between the sung lines
bansuri flute, violin section in Indian-style unison, plucked veena, felt piano, acoustic guitar, deep warm round bass, tabla and dholak keherwa groove with a soft kick and claps
all instruments close, dry and natural, played by real musicians

positive_local_styles: the female voice hums the love melody softly
the voice sings the love melody with words
groove, bass and acoustic guitar enter
the flute answers each line with a small echo of the melody
flute and violins play a variation of the same melody together in unison
the voice sings a verse built from the same melody's opening notes
the same love melody at its happiest and fullest
voice, violins and flute together in unison
the voice sings the last line softly once more, then hums
ending on a warm bright G major chord
